title: The Mirror in the Mud
subtitle: Is a friend a companion for the flight, or just a mirror for their own shadows?

characters.name: Kalu
characters.description: A creature of the open sky who believes that long summers of shared flight earn a lifetime of trust.

characters.name: Chama
characters.description: A ground-dweller haunted by his own past, who projects his own shadows onto those closest to him.

characters.name: Damini
characters.description: A cunning spirit who knows that the easiest way to break a bond is to whisper a lie that sounds like an old memory.
